account_access: Cannot sign in, reset a password, or complete authentication.
cancel_subscription: Wants to end a paid subscription or prevent renewal.
duplicate_charge: The same purchase appears to have been charged more than once.
refund_status: Asks about the timing, progress, or absence of an expected refund.
plan_change: Wants to upgrade, downgrade, or change billing cycle or seats.
invoice_request: Needs an invoice, receipt, tax detail, or billing document.
technical_bug: An existing product capability is broken or behaves incorrectly.
feature_request: Proposes or asks for a product capability that does not exist.
